name: Trend-template breakout
entry: close > sma(150) and sma(150) > sma(200) and sma(50) > sma(150) and pct_from_high(252) >= -25 and close > shift(highest(high, 20), 1) and rel_volume(50) >= 1.4 and percentile(atr_pct(14), 60) <= 50
_about: Minervini/O'Neil-style: stage-2 trend, quiet base (low ATR percentile), breakout on volume. 7% max stop, 3R target, ATR trail.
